passive.name: Time In A Bottle
passive.description: Zilean stores time as Experience and can grant it to his allies. When he has enough Experience to finish an ally's level up, he can right-click them to impart it. Zilean receives as much Experience as he gives.

spells.name: Time Bomb
spells.description: Tosses a bomb to target area that sticks to units that come near it (prioritizes Champions). It detonates after 3 seconds, dealing area of effect damage. If a Time Bomb is detonated early by another Time Bomb, it also stuns enemies.
spells.tooltip:
Zilean tosses a time-delayed bomb that sticks to the first unit which comes within a small area around it. After {{ fuseduration }} seconds it detonates, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.

Placing a second bomb on a unit that already has one detonates the first bomb immediately and Stuns enemies in the blast for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Rewind
spells.description: Zilean can prepare himself for future confrontations, reducing the cooldowns of his other basic abilities.
spells.tooltip: Zilean turns time, reducing his other basic Ability Cooldowns by {{ cooldownreduction }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Time Warp
spells.description: Zilean bends time around any unit, decreasing an enemy's Move Speed or increasing an ally's Move Speed for a short time.
spells.tooltip: Zilean <status>Slows</status> an enemy champion by {{ speedamount }}% or grants an allied champion <speed>{{ speedamount }}% Move Speed</speed> for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Chronoshift
spells.description: Zilean places a protective time rune on an allied champion, teleporting the champion back in time if they take lethal damage.
spells.tooltip: Zilean grants a protective time rune to an allied champion for {{ rduration }} seconds. If the target would die, the rune rewinds their timeline, putting them into Stasis for {{ revivestateduration }} seconds, then reviving them and restoring <healing>{{ rtotalheal }} Health</healing>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Time in a Bottle
effects: Innate: Zilean generates 2 / 3.5 / 5 / 6 / 12 (based on level) experience (does not count towards his own level up) every 5 seconds. Time in a Bottle is on cooldown when the game starts and becomes disabled when everyone on Zilean's team including himself has reached level 18.

When he has stored enough to level up an allied champion and grant the same amount of experience to himself, he can select them to channel for 1.2 seconds after a 0.5-second cast time. The channel is interrupted and disabled upon entering combat with enemy champions or taking damage from turrets, placing it on a 10-second cooldown. If Zilean interrupts it himself, it is placed on a 1-second cooldown, increased to 2 if he used a basic attack against a turret to do so.
A successful channel will grant an equal amount of experience to the ally to-level-up and Zilean, with a combined minimum of 15% his stored experience.

variants.name: Time Bomb
effects: Active: Zilean throws a ticking time bomb to the target location that grants sight of its surroundings. The bomb will attach itself to units that move within the epicenter, or those hit directly, revealing them.

variants.name: Rewind
effects: Active: Zilean reduces the remaining cooldowns of Time Bomb and Time Warp by 10 seconds each.
Either Time Bomb or Time Warp must be on cooldown to cast this ability.

variants.name: Time Warp
effects: Active: Zilean applies Time Warp to the target champion which lasts for 2.5 seconds.

variants.name: Chronoshift
effects: Active: Zilean places a protective time rune on the target allied champion or himself for 5 seconds.
